response.original_title: Clan Of Xymox: Live At Castle Party
response.overview: Clan of Xymox – Live At Castle Party was released as a CD+DVD digipak set in September 2011 (Big Blue Records / Xymox Control), documenting the Dutch dark wave/gothic pioneers' performance at the 2010 Castle Party festival — the largest Dark Independent festival, held at Bolków Castle in Poland.  This marked the first time in the band's history that a complete concert recording appeared on CD and DVD
response.title: Clan Of Xymox: Live At Castle Party
